nodes.label: poc Scope
nodes.rationale: Minimal depth, advisory review cap, 8 of 32. A spike answers one question - can this work? - so it keeps only intent-capture, reverse-engineering, requirements-analysis, code-generation and build-and-test. Discarding the design and operation ceremony is the point, because the artifact is throwaway; a yes answer means re-scoping to feature or mvp for the real build.
